initialExam.title: SLET/SET 2026 (State Level Eligibility Test)
initialExam.description: State Level Eligibility Test / State Eligibility Test for eligibility as Assistant Professor in universities and colleges within the respective state. Conducted by UGC-accredited state agencies.
initialExam.eligibility: Post-Graduate with 55% marks in relevant subject
initialExam.syllabus: Paper I: Teaching Aptitude, Research Methodology, Reasoning, Data Interpretation, ICT, Higher Education. Paper II: Subject-specific.
initialExam.examPattern: Paper I: 50 questions, 100 marks. Paper II: 100 questions, 200 marks. Total: 3 hours.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Test → SLET/SET Certificate → Eligible for Assistant Professor in state
initialExam.jobRole: Assistant Professor in universities and colleges (state-level eligibility)
initialExam.careerGrowth: Assistant Professor → Associate Professor → Professor → Dean → Vice Chancellor.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit state SLET website 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit

salaryRange.description: UGC 7th CPC Pay Level 10 for Assistant Professor

initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, LTC, Academic allowance, Research grants
